NBO_AccumulateAssociation.text:
import NBO_AllCalls
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBO_AccumulateAssociation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
abbrev sourceOps (ops : Ops) := NBF_Accumulate.install ops
/-- Concrete reference dictionary: both loop callbacks are the SAME emitted
source loops with the installed retained basis/row primitives. No returned
accumulation or loop-result equality is a parameter. -/
def reference (ops : Ops) : AccumulateOps :=
 {zero:=(sourceOps ops).op4,one:=(sourceOps ops).op5,
  basisLoop:=verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0 (sourceOps ops),
  weightLoop:=verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 (sourceOps ops),
  mulE:=(sourceOps ops).op3,addE:=(sourceOps ops).op2,
  trace:=(sourceOps ops).op15,mulK:=(sourceOps ops).op9}
def prefixRun (ops : Ops) (a : verifier.Accumulator) (node : U32)
 (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) : Result verifier.BatchedWeights := do
 let width:=alloc.vec.Vec.len a.weights
 let zero ← (sourceOps ops).op4
 let one ← (sourceOps ops).op5
 let initial ← Array.update (Array.repeat 256#usize zero) 0#usize one
 let basis ← verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0 (sourceOps ops)
   one node width initial 1#usize
 verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 (sourceOps ops)
   {start:=0#usize,«end»:=width} a.weights a.power a.next b width basis
private theorem associate {A B C : Type} (x : Result A) (f : A → Result B)
 (g : B → Result C) : ((x >>= f) >>= g) = (x >>= fun a=>f a >>= g) := by
 cases x <;> rfl
/-- The actual successful row prefix preserves the source counter. -/
theorem prefix_terms (ops : Ops) (a : verifier.Accumulator) (node : U32)
 (b mid : verifier.BatchedWeights) (size : a.weights.val.length=64)
 (raw : b.raw.val.length=64) (run : prefixRun ops a node b=ok mid) : mid.terms=b.terms := by
 have width : alloc.vec.Vec.len a.weights=64#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq size
 unfold prefixRun at run
 rw [width] at run
 iterate 4 obtain ⟨x,hx,run⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ run
 exact (Port3_NativeRowLoop.fields (sourceOps ops) a.weights a.power a.next 64#usize
   _ 64 {start:=0#usize,«end»:=64#usize} b mid (by decide)
   (by change 64≤b.raw.val.length;omega) run).2
/-- Exact whole Result association to the checked reference accumulation on
its reached numeric domain, including failures/divergence in any child.
Both actual loops are installed above; no successful-final-result is supplied. -/
theorem source (ops : Ops) (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
 (node : U32) (value : Stage2E) (b : verifier.BatchedWeights)
 (size : a.weights.val.length=64) (raw : b.raw.val.length=64)
 (active : a.next.val<10) (sync : b.terms=a.next) :
 verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node (sourceOps ops) p a node value b =
 AspisR1Stage2.verifier.accumulateWithOps (reference ops) p a node value b := by
 have next := Port3_Wrapping.checked_add a.next 1#usize (by change a.next.val+1≤4096;omega)
 have nativeShell : verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node (sourceOps ops) p a node value b =
   (do let mid ← prefixRun ops a node b
       let term ← lift (Usize.wrapping_add mid.terms 1#usize)
       let product ← (sourceOps ops).op3 value a.power
       let rhs ← (sourceOps ops).op2 a.rhs product
       (sourceOps ops).op15 11#u16 a.next rhs
       let power ← (sourceOps ops).op9 a.power p.rho
       let successor ← lift (Usize.wrapping_add a.next 1#usize)
       ok ({a with rhs:=rhs,power:=power,next:=successor},{mid with terms:=term})) := by
   unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node prefixRun
   simp only [associate,bind_tc_ok]
 have referenceShell : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.accumulateWithOps (reference ops) p a node value b =
   (do let mid ← prefixRun ops a node b
       let term ← mid.terms+1#usize
       let product ← (sourceOps ops).op3 value a.power
       let rhs ← (sourceOps ops).op2 a.rhs product
       (sourceOps ops).op15 11#u16 a.next rhs
       let power ← (sourceOps ops).op9 a.power p.rho
       let successor ← a.next+1#usize
       ok ({a with rhs:=rhs,power:=power,next:=successor},{mid with terms:=term})) := by
   unfold AspisR1Stage2.verifier.accumulateWithOps reference prefixRun
   simp only [associate,bind_tc_ok]
 rw [nativeShell,referenceShell]
 cases hprefix : prefixRun ops a node b with
 | fail e => rfl
 | div => rfl
 | ok mid =>
   have terms := prefix_terms ops a node b mid size raw hprefix
   have term := Port3_Wrapping.checked_add mid.terms 1#usize
     (by rw [terms,sync];change a.next.val+1≤4096;omega)
   simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok,term,next]
#print axioms associate
#print axioms prefix_terms
#print axioms source
end NBO_AccumulateAssociation
end

NBO_AllCalls.text:
import NBO_FieldSemantics
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBO_AllCalls
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
/-- Chronological successful prefixes of this SAME actual query body. A
rejected/failing final query still has its input at one of these prefixes. -/
inductive Prefix (ops : Ops) (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared)
 (g : Array Stage2E 29#usize) (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry)
 (initial : verifier.Accumulator) (pending : verifier.BatchedWeights) :
 verifier.Accumulator → verifier.BatchedWeights → Prop
 | initial : Prefix ops proof p g geometry initial pending initial pending
 | step {a out : verifier.Accumulator} {b bout : verifier.BatchedWeights}
   (prior : Prefix ops proof p g geometry initial pending a b)
   (active : a.next.val<10)
   (run : verifier.candidate.query_values (NBF_Accumulate.install ops)
     proof p a g none geometry b=ok (.Ok (out,bout))) :
   Prefix ops proof p g geometry initial pending out bout

def CanonicalWeights (v : alloc.vec.Vec NBF_RowInstall.Q) : Prop :=
 ∀ q ∈ v.val, NBF_PowerStep.Canonical q

theorem initial_weights (base : VTop_Stages.Ops) (reserved : Bool)
 (a : verifier.Accumulator)
 (run : (Port3_Initial.install base reserved).op12 .S2=ok (.Ok a)) :
 CanonicalWeights a.weights := by
 obtain ⟨_,weights,_,_,_⟩ := Port3_Initial.accepted_fields base reserved a run
 unfold CanonicalWeights
 rw [weights]
 intro q member
 obtain ⟨_,same⟩ := List.mem_replicate.mp member
 subst q
 intro k
 fin_cases k <;> decide
/-- Every reached caller obtains its row/power/rhs phase and all original
weight embedding inputs from the SAME constructors and earlier returns.
No independent invariant or selected canonical vector is supplied. -/
theorem reached (base : VTop_Stages.Ops) (reserved : Bool) (ops : Ops)
 (lower : NBO_QueryDomains.Lower ops) (bindings : NBO_FieldSemantics.NBC_Bindings ops)
 (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared) (prepared : NBO_AcceptedTail.PreparedDomain p)
 (g : Array Stage2E 29#usize) (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry)
 (domain : NBO_QueryDomains.GeometryDomain geometry)
 (initial a : verifier.Accumulator) (pending b : verifier.BatchedWeights)
 (initRun : (Port3_Initial.install base reserved).op12 .S2=ok (.Ok initial))
 (pendingRun : Port3_NativePendingInstall.source reserved initial.weights.deref=ok (.Ok pending))
 (prefixRun : Prefix ops proof p g geometry initial pending a b) :
 NBO_QueryRhs.Good a b ∧ a.weights=initial.weights ∧
 CanonicalWeights a.weights ∧ a.next.val≤10 := by
 have fields := NBO_FieldSemantics.fields ops bindings
 obtain ⟨next,good⟩ := NBF_QueryInitial.good base reserved initial pending initRun pendingRun
 have initialRhs := NBO_TailDomain.initial base reserved initial initRun
 have initialWeights := initial_weights base reserved initial initRun
 induction prefixRun with
 | initial => exact ⟨⟨good,initialRhs⟩,rfl,initialWeights,by rw [next];decide⟩
 | @step a out b bout prior active run ih =>
   have frame := Port3_NativeQueryFrame.query_fields (NBF_Accumulate.install ops)
     proof p a out g none geometry b bout run
   refine ⟨⟨NBF_QueryInvariant.step ops fields.power proof p g geometry prepared.rho
     a out b bout ih.1.1 active run,
     (NBO_AcceptedTail.canonical ops lower fields proof p prepared a out g geometry
       domain b bout active ih.1.1 ih.1.2 run).1⟩,
     frame.2.1.trans ih.2.1,?_,?_⟩
   · rw [frame.2.1];exact ih.2.2.1
   · rw [frame.2.2];omega
#print axioms initial_weights
#print axioms reached
end NBO_AllCalls
end

NBO_FieldSemantics.text:
import NBO_FieldPorts
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBO_FieldSemantics
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open NBO_FieldPorts
open NBO_TailDomain (WideCanonical)
def add (x y : Stage2E) : Result Stage2E := do
 let a ← AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31.add (toQ x.c0) (toQ y.c0)
 let b ← AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31.add (toQ x.c1) (toQ y.c1)
 ok (fromE (a,b))
def product (x : Stage2E) (q : Q) : Result Stage2E := do
 let a ← AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31.mul (toQ x.c0) (toQ q)
 let b ← AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31.mul (toQ x.c1) (toQ q)
 ok (fromE (a,b))
def power (x y : Q) : Result Q := do
 let q ← AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31.mul (toQ x) (toQ y)
 ok (fromQ q)
/-- Reuse exact retained probe arithmetic; only carrier transport is new. -/
theorem add_total (x y : Stage2E) (hx : WideCanonical x) (hy : WideCanonical y) :
 ∃ out, add x y=ok out ∧ WideCanonical out := by
 obtain ⟨a,ha,ca,_⟩ := ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact
   (toQ x.c0) (toQ y.c0) ((canonicalQ _).mp hx.1) ((canonicalQ _).mp hy.1)
 obtain ⟨b,hb,cb,_⟩ := ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact
   (toQ x.c1) (toQ y.c1) ((canonicalQ _).mp hx.2) ((canonicalQ _).mp hy.2)
 exact ⟨fromE (a,b),by simp only [add,ha,hb,bind_tc_ok],fromE_canonical _ ⟨ca,cb⟩⟩
theorem product_total (x : Stage2E) (q : Q)
 (hx : WideCanonical x) (hq : NBF_PowerStep.Canonical q) :
 ∃ out, product x q=ok out ∧ WideCanonical out := by
 obtain ⟨a,ha,ca,_⟩ := ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact
   (toQ x.c0) (toQ q) ((canonicalQ _).mp hx.1) ((canonicalQ _).mp hq)
 obtain ⟨b,hb,cb,_⟩ := ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact
   (toQ x.c1) (toQ q) ((canonicalQ _).mp hx.2) ((canonicalQ _).mp hq)
 exact ⟨fromE (a,b),by simp only [product,ha,hb,bind_tc_ok],fromE_canonical _ ⟨ca,cb⟩⟩
theorem power_total (x y : Q) (hx : NBF_PowerStep.Canonical x)
 (hy : NBF_PowerStep.Canonical y) :
 ∃ out, power x y=ok out ∧ NBF_PowerStep.Canonical out := by
 obtain ⟨q,hq,cq,_⟩ := ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact
   (toQ x) (toQ y) ((canonicalQ _).mp hx) ((canonicalQ _).mp hy)
 exact ⟨fromQ q,by simp only [power,hq,bind_tc_ok],fromQ_canonical _ cq⟩
/-- Exact remaining NBC source-to-probe statements. Each is ONE field
operation on its canonical argument domain, never an accumulator/query result. -/
structure NBC_Bindings (ops : Ops) : Prop where
 sum : ∀ x y, WideCanonical x → WideCanonical y → ops.op2 x y=add x y
 product : ∀ x q, WideCanonical x → NBF_PowerStep.Canonical q → ops.op3 x q=product x q
 power : ∀ x y, NBF_PowerStep.Canonical x → NBF_PowerStep.Canonical y → ops.op9 x y=power x y
/-- Domain-only tail premises follow from exact lower operation bindings. -/
theorem fields (ops : Ops) (bindings : NBC_Bindings ops) : NBO_TailDomain.NBC_Fields ops := by
 constructor
 · intro x q out hx hq run
   rw [bindings.product x q hx hq] at run
   obtain ⟨expected,hexpected,canonical⟩ := product_total x q hx hq
   have same := Result.ok.inj (hexpected.symm.trans run)
   simpa only [same] using canonical
 · intro x y out hx hy run
   rw [bindings.sum x y hx hy] at run
   obtain ⟨expected,hexpected,canonical⟩ := add_total x y hx hy
   have same := Result.ok.inj (hexpected.symm.trans run)
   simpa only [same] using canonical
 · intro x y out hx hy run
   rw [bindings.power x y hx hy] at run
   obtain ⟨expected,hexpected,canonical⟩ := power_total x y hx hy
   have same := Result.ok.inj (hexpected.symm.trans run)
   simpa only [same] using canonical
#print axioms add_total
#print axioms product_total
#print axioms power_total
#print axioms fields
end NBO_FieldSemantics
end

NBO_FieldPorts.text:
import NBO_Release
import ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBO_FieldPorts
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
abbrev Q := aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev NQ := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31
abbrev NE := NQ × NQ
def toQ (x : Q) : NQ := ⟨⟨x.c0.a,x.c0.b⟩,⟨x.c1.a,x.c1.b⟩⟩
def fromQ (x : NQ) : Q := ⟨⟨x.c0.a,x.c0.b⟩,⟨x.c1.a,x.c1.b⟩⟩
def toE (x : Stage2E) : NE := ⟨toQ x.c0,toQ x.c1⟩
def fromE (x : NE) : Stage2E := ⟨fromQ x.1,fromQ x.2⟩
theorem q_roundtrip (x : Q) : fromQ (toQ x)=x := rfl
theorem e_roundtrip (x : Stage2E) : fromE (toE x)=x := rfl
theorem probe_q_roundtrip (x : NQ) : toQ (fromQ x)=x := rfl
theorem probe_e_roundtrip (x : NE) : toE (fromE x)=x := rfl
/-- Literal limb transport into the already proved extracted probe carrier.
No new arithmetic theorem or native multiplication gate is introduced. -/
theorem canonicalQ (x : Q) :
 NBF_PowerStep.Canonical x ↔ ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM (toQ x) := by
 constructor
 · intro h
   exact ⟨⟨h 0,h 1⟩,⟨h 2,h 3⟩⟩
 · rintro ⟨⟨h0,h1⟩,⟨h2,h3⟩⟩ k
   fin_cases k <;> assumption
theorem canonicalE (x : Stage2E) :
 NBO_TailDomain.WideCanonical x ↔ (ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM (toE x).1 ∧ ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM (toE x).2) := by
 exact and_congr (canonicalQ x.c0) (canonicalQ x.c1)
theorem fromQ_canonical (x : NQ) (h : ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM x) :
 NBF_PowerStep.Canonical (fromQ x) :=
 (canonicalQ _).mpr (by simpa only [probe_q_roundtrip] using h)
theorem fromE_canonical (x : NE) (h : (ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM x.1 ∧ ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM x.2)) :
 NBO_TailDomain.WideCanonical (fromE x) :=
 (canonicalE _).mpr (by simpa only [probe_e_roundtrip] using h)
#print axioms q_roundtrip
#print axioms e_roundtrip
#print axioms probe_q_roundtrip
#print axioms probe_e_roundtrip
#print axioms canonicalQ
#print axioms canonicalE
#print axioms fromQ_canonical
#print axioms fromE_canonical
end NBO_FieldPorts
end

import NBO_TopInstall
import NBO_GeometryDomain
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBO_Release
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
/-- Release trace/observer installation preserves every lower operation law. -/
theorem lower (ops : Ops) (laws : NBO_QueryDomains.Lower ops) :
 NBO_QueryDomains.Lower (Port3_QueryStage.release ops) :=
 ⟨laws.decode,laws.fromFn,laws.inverse,laws.line⟩
theorem fields (ops : Ops) (laws : NBO_TailDomain.NBC_Fields ops) :
 NBO_TailDomain.NBC_Fields (Port3_QueryStage.release ops) :=
 ⟨laws.product,laws.sum,laws.power⟩
/-- Reuse the actual retained source-shaped mark definition at None. -/
theorem mark_none (ops : Ops) (phase : verifier.Phase) :
 (Port3_QueryStage.release ops).op19
   none phase=ok () := by
 exact Port3_QueryStage.mark_none phase
#print axioms lower
#print axioms fields
#print axioms mark_none
end NBO_Release
end

NBO_TopInstall.text:
import NBO_QueryRhs
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBO_TopInstall
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
/-- Only the previously checked initialization/pending/query/flush/split
operations are installed; all preparation, authentication and geometry stay
on their original base dictionary. -/
def query (ops : Ops) (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared)
 (a : verifier.Accumulator) (g : Array Stage2E 29#usize)
 (obs : Option (VTop_Stages.verifier.Phase → Result Unit))
 (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry) (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (end1 : Usize) :=
 Port3_QueryInstall.result (verifier.candidate.query_loop (NBF_Accumulate.install ops)
   proof p a g (Port3_QueryInstall.observer obs) geometry b end1)
def install (base : VTop_Stages.Ops) (reserved : Bool) (ops : Ops) : VTop_Stages.Ops :=
 {Port3_Initial.install base reserved with
   op6:=query ops
   op9:=Port3_FlushInstall.flush
   op10:=Port3_NativePendingInstall.source reserved
   op16:=ok 10#usize}
/-- Exact lower producer statements, on the SAME successful preparation and
geometry calls used by the actual top prefix. No final/query equality enters. -/
structure Producers (base : VTop_Stages.Ops) : Prop where
 prepared : ∀ {Hash : Type} (D : VTop_Stages.aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Hash) hash
   semantic proof initial preparation g p,
   base.op7 D semantic proof hash none initial=ok (preparation,g) →
   core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch preparation=ok (.Continue p) →
   NBO_AcceptedTail.PreparedDomain p
 geometry : ∀ queries split geometry,
   split.val=10 → base.op11 queries 0#usize split=ok (.Ok geometry) →
   NBO_QueryDomains.GeometryDomain geometry
/-- SAME accepted writer prefix supplies constructors, query execution,
returned state and flush; the dependent rhs/phase/width properties are derived.
This is the installed model consumer, not a native whole-TX1 refinement. -/
theorem reached (base : VTop_Stages.Ops) (reserved : Bool) (ops : Ops)
 (producers : Producers base) (lower : NBO_QueryDomains.Lower ops)
 (fields : NBO_TailDomain.NBC_Fields ops)
 {Hash : Type} (D : VTop_Stages.aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Hash) (hash : Hash)
 (semantic : VTop_Stages.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
 (proof : Slice U8) (split : Usize) (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
 (prefixRun : VTop_Provenance.WriterPrefix (install base reserved ops)
   D hash semantic proof split none p a) :
 split.val=10 ∧ a.next.val=10 ∧ a.weights.val.length=64 ∧
 NBO_TailDomain.WideCanonical a.rhs ∧ NBF_PowerStep.Canonical a.power ∧
 (∀ q ∈ a.weights.val, Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical q) := by
 obtain ⟨zero,g,prep,initial,root,geometry,pending,returned,flushed,parsed,sv,
   hs,hsv,hparse,hscan,hzero,hprep,hbranch,hinit,hbatch,hgeom,hpending,hquery,hflush,
   hw,hr,hp,hn⟩ := prefixRun
 have split10 : split.val=10 := by
   have eq : (10#usize : Usize)=sv := Result.ok.inj hs
   subst sv;exact hsv
 have splitEq : split=10#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq split10
 have prepared := producers.prepared D hash semantic proof (Array.repeat 29#usize zero)
   prep g p hprep hbranch
 have domain := producers.geometry p.queries split geometry split10 hgeom
 have initialRun : (Port3_Initial.install base reserved).op12 .S2=ok (.Ok initial) := hinit
 have pendingRun : Port3_NativePendingInstall.source reserved initial.weights.deref=
   ok (.Ok pending) := hpending
 have queryRun : verifier.candidate.query_loop (NBF_Accumulate.install ops)
   proof p initial g none geometry pending 10#usize=ok (.Ok returned) := by
   change query ops proof p initial g none geometry pending split=_ at hquery
   unfold query at hquery
   have h := (Port3_QueryInstall.success_iff _ _).mp hquery
   simpa only [Port3_QueryInstall.observer,Option.map_none,splitEq] using h
 have good := NBO_QueryRhs.from_constructors base reserved ops lower fields proof p prepared
   g geometry domain initial returned.1 pending returned.2 initialRun pendingRun queryRun
 obtain ⟨next,terms,weights,raw,progress⟩ := NBF_QueryLoop.from_constructors base reserved ops
   fields.power proof p g geometry prepared.rho initial returned.1 pending returned.2
   initialRun pendingRun queryRun
 have length : flushed.val.length=64 :=
   (Port3_FlushInstall.accepted_contents returned.2 returned.1.weights.deref flushed
     (by change returned.1.weights.val.length≤returned.2.raw.val.length;omega) hflush).2.trans weights
 have canonical := Port3_FlushInstall.accepted_canonical returned.2 returned.1.weights.deref
   flushed (by change returned.1.weights.val.length≤returned.2.raw.val.length;omega) hflush
 exact ⟨split10,by rw [hn];exact next,
   by rw [hw];exact length,by rw [hr];exact good.2,
   by rw [hp];exact good.1.power,by rw [hw];exact canonical⟩
#print axioms reached
end NBO_TopInstall
end

NBO_QueryRhs.text:
import NBO_AcceptedTail
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBO_QueryRhs
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open NBO_TailDomain (WideCanonical)
def Good (a : verifier.Accumulator) (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) : Prop :=
 NBF_QueryInvariant.Good a b ∧ WideCanonical a.rhs
def StateGood (s : NBB_QueryTrace.State) : Prop :=
 match s with | .Err _=>True | .Ok (a,b)=>Good a b
def ResultGood (s : Result NBB_QueryTrace.State) : Prop :=
 match s with | .fail _=>True | .div=>True | .ok s=>StateGood s
/-- Chronological induction now carries the rhs multiplication domain as
well as the inherited power/row domain, including error/failure/divergence. -/
theorem trace (ops : Ops) (lower : NBO_QueryDomains.Lower ops)
 (fields : NBO_TailDomain.NBC_Fields ops)
 (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared) (prepared : NBO_AcceptedTail.PreparedDomain p)
 (g : Array Stage2E 29#usize) (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry)
 (domain : NBO_QueryDomains.GeometryDomain geometry)
 (state : NBB_QueryTrace.State) (out : Result NBB_QueryTrace.State)
 (history : NBB_QueryTrace.Trace (fun a b=>verifier.candidate.query_values
   (NBF_Accumulate.install ops) proof p a g none geometry b) 10 state out) :
 StateGood state → ResultGood out := by
 induction history with
 | error => intro good;trivial
 | stop => intro good;exact good
 | @step a b reply out active head tail ih =>
   intro good
   apply ih
   cases reply with
   | Err e=>trivial
   | Ok pair=>
     rcases pair with ⟨a1,b1⟩
     exact ⟨NBF_QueryInvariant.step ops fields.power proof p g geometry prepared.rho
       a a1 b b1 good.1 active head,
       (NBO_AcceptedTail.canonical ops lower fields proof p prepared a a1 g geometry
         domain b b1 active good.1 good.2 head).1⟩
 | fail => intro good;trivial
 | div => intro good;trivial
/-- SAME constructors and SAME accepted loop; no initial canonicality,
row phase, selected prefix output or final rhs property is a premise. -/
theorem from_constructors (base : VTop_Stages.Ops) (reserved : Bool)
 (ops : Ops) (lower : NBO_QueryDomains.Lower ops) (fields : NBO_TailDomain.NBC_Fields ops)
 (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared) (prepared : NBO_AcceptedTail.PreparedDomain p)
 (g : Array Stage2E 29#usize) (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry)
 (domain : NBO_QueryDomains.GeometryDomain geometry)
 (a out : verifier.Accumulator) (b bout : verifier.BatchedWeights)
 (initial : (Port3_Initial.install base reserved).op12 .S2=ok (.Ok a))
 (pending : Port3_NativePendingInstall.source reserved a.weights.deref=ok (.Ok b))
 (run : verifier.candidate.query_loop (NBF_Accumulate.install ops)
   proof p a g none geometry b 10#usize=ok (.Ok (out,bout))) : Good out bout := by
 obtain ⟨_,good⟩ := NBF_QueryInitial.good base reserved a b initial pending
 obtain ⟨result,history,same⟩ := NBB_QueryWitness.direct (NBF_Accumulate.install ops)
   proof p g none geometry 10#usize a b
 have eq : result=ok (.Ok (out,bout)) := same.symm.trans run
 rw [eq] at history
 exact trace ops lower fields proof p prepared g geometry domain (.Ok (a,b))
   (ok (.Ok (out,bout)))
   (by simpa only [show (10#usize).val=10 from rfl] using history)
   ⟨good,NBO_TailDomain.initial base reserved a initial⟩
#print axioms trace
#print axioms from_constructors
end NBO_QueryRhs

import NBO_QueryDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBO_AcceptedTail
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open Port3_PushFrame (bind_success)
open NBO_TailDomain (WideCanonical)
structure PreparedDomain (p : verifier.Prepared) : Prop where
 alpha1 : WideCanonical (p.alpha.val[1]'(by rw [p.alpha.property];decide))
 rho : NBF_PowerStep.Canonical p.rho
/-- Installs the SAME lower callback laws through the existing basis/row
installation; the four relevant callback definitions are unchanged. -/
def installed (ops : Ops) (lower : NBO_QueryDomains.Lower ops) :
 NBO_QueryDomains.Lower (NBF_Accumulate.install ops) :=
 ⟨lower.decode,lower.fromFn,lower.inverse,lower.line⟩
/-- Every line-fold input domain comes from the SAME prefix's producers.
Only named lower operation laws and upstream prepared/geometry domains remain. -/
theorem reached (ops : Ops) (lower : NBO_QueryDomains.Lower ops)
 (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared) (prepared : PreparedDomain p)
 (a out : verifier.Accumulator) (g : Array Stage2E 29#usize)
 (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry) (domain : NBO_QueryDomains.GeometryDomain geometry)
 (b bout : verifier.BatchedWeights) (active : a.next.val<10)
 (run : verifier.candidate.query_values (NBF_Accumulate.install ops)
   proof p a g none geometry b=ok (.Ok (out,bout))) :
 ∃ node line, WideCanonical line ∧
 verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node (NBF_Accumulate.install ops)
   p a node line b=ok (out,bout) := by
 rw [NBO_QueryFactor.association] at run
 obtain ⟨cut,hfront,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
 cases cut with
 | Err error => cases run
 | Ok cut =>
   rcases cut with ⟨circle,values,inverse⟩
   obtain ⟨hvalues,hinverse⟩ := NBO_QueryDomains.front
     (NBF_Accumulate.install ops) (installed ops lower) proof p a.next g geometry
     domain active circle values inverse hfront
   unfold NBO_QueryFactor.suffix at run
   obtain ⟨alpha,halpha,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
   obtain ⟨line,hline,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
   have same : alpha=p.alpha.val[1]'(by rw [p.alpha.property];decide) := by
     simpa [Array.index_usize] using halpha.symm
   have canonical : WideCanonical line := lower.line alpha values inverse line
     (by rw [same];exact prepared.alpha1) hvalues hinverse hline
   iterate 9 obtain ⟨x,hx,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
   obtain ⟨pair,haccum,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
   rcases pair with ⟨a1,b1⟩
   obtain ⟨marked,hmarked,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
   cases Result.ok.inj run
   exact ⟨_,line,canonical,haccum⟩
/-- rhs and power canonicality are conclusions of the SAME successful
query, with raw progress and scalar inputs supplied by its reached invariant. -/
theorem canonical (ops : Ops) (lower : NBO_QueryDomains.Lower ops)
 (fields : NBO_TailDomain.NBC_Fields ops)
 (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared) (prepared : PreparedDomain p)
 (a out : verifier.Accumulator) (g : Array Stage2E 29#usize)
 (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry) (domain : NBO_QueryDomains.GeometryDomain geometry)
 (b bout : verifier.BatchedWeights) (active : a.next.val<10)
 (good : NBF_QueryInvariant.Good a b) (rhs : WideCanonical a.rhs)
 (run : verifier.candidate.query_values (NBF_Accumulate.install ops)
   proof p a g none geometry b=ok (.Ok (out,bout))) :
 WideCanonical out.rhs ∧ NBF_PowerStep.Canonical out.power := by
 obtain ⟨node,line,hcanonical,haccum⟩ := reached ops lower proof p prepared a out g
   geometry domain b bout active run
 exact NBO_TailDomain.accumulate ops fields p a out node line b bout good.weights
   (by rw [good.sync];exact good.phase) good.power prepared.rho rhs hcanonical haccum
#print axioms installed
#print axioms reached
#print axioms canonical
end NBO_AcceptedTail
end

import NBO_TailDomain
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBO_QueryDomains
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open Port3_PushFrame (bind_success)
open NBO_TailDomain (WideCanonical)
def AllWide {n : Usize} (v : Array Stage2E n) : Prop :=
 ∀ x ∈ v.val, WideCanonical x
def AllBase {n : Usize} (v : Array U32 n) : Prop :=
 ∀ x ∈ v.val, x.val<2147483647
structure GeometryDomain (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry) : Prop where
 start : geometry.start=0#usize
 inverseLength : geometry.inverses.val.length=10
 lineLength : geometry.line_z.val.length=10
 inverse : ∀ row ∈ geometry.inverses.val, AllBase row
 line : ∀ x ∈ geometry.line_z.val, x.val<2147483647
/-- Lower decoder, standard-array, geometry lookup and field result laws.
These are exact named dependencies, not native-query or accepted-result laws.
The geometry producer and prepared alpha domain remain separate lower rows. -/
structure Lower (ops : Ops) : Prop where
 decode : ∀ bytes i out, ops.op21 bytes i=ok out → WideCanonical out
 fromFn : ∀ {T F : Type} (n : Usize) (dict : core.ops.function.FnMut F Usize T)
   (initial : F) (out : Array T n) (property : T → Prop),
   (∀ state i x next, dict.call_mut state i=ok (x,next) → property x) →
   ops.op0 n dict initial=ok out → ∀ x ∈ out.val, property x
 inverse : ∀ geometry i inverse, GeometryDomain geometry → i.val<10 →
   ops.op18 geometry i=ok inverse → AllBase inverse
 line : ∀ alpha values inverse out, WideCanonical alpha → AllWide values →
   AllBase inverse → ops.op16 alpha values inverse=ok out → WideCanonical out
/-- Success of the SAME decoder closure derives its canonical reply, even
when the input bytes are malformed: failure supplies no successful reply. -/
theorem closure (ops : Ops) (lower : Lower ops)
 (c : verifier.candidate.query_values.closure) (i : Usize)
 (value : Stage2E) (next : verifier.candidate.query_values.closure)
 (run : verifier.candidate.query_values.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeWideExact.call_mut
   ops c i=ok (value,next)) : WideCanonical value := by
 unfold verifier.candidate.query_values.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeWideExact.call_mut at run
 obtain ⟨bytes,hbytes,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
 obtain ⟨decoded,hdecoded,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
 cases Result.ok.inj run
 exact lower.decode bytes i value hdecoded
/-- Values and inverse are the exact successful prefix returns. Their
canonicality is a conclusion, rather than a separately selected witness. -/
theorem front (ops : Ops) (lower : Lower ops) (proof : Slice U8)
 (p : verifier.Prepared) (next : Usize) (g : Array Stage2E 29#usize)
 (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry) (domain : GeometryDomain geometry)
 (active : next.val<10) (circle : Stage2E) (values : Array Stage2E 4#usize)
 (inverse : Array U32 5#usize)
 (run : NBO_QueryFactor.front ops proof p next g geometry=ok (.Ok (circle,values,inverse))) :
 AllWide values ∧ AllBase inverse := by
 unfold NBO_QueryFactor.front at run
 iterate 4 obtain ⟨x,hx,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
 iterate 15 obtain ⟨x,hx,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
 obtain ⟨inv,hinv,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
 iterate 4 obtain ⟨x,hx,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
 obtain ⟨vals,hvals,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
 iterate 3 obtain ⟨x,hx,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
 split at run
 · cases run
 · cases Result.ok.inj run
   exact ⟨lower.fromFn _ _ _ values WideCanonical (closure ops lower) hvals,
     lower.inverse geometry next inverse domain active hinv⟩
#print axioms closure
#print axioms front
end NBO_QueryDomains
end

NBO_TailDomain.text:
import NBO_QueryFactor
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBO_TailDomain
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open Port3_PushFrame (bind_success)
def WideCanonical (x : Stage2E) : Prop :=
 NBF_PowerStep.Canonical x.c0 ∧ NBF_PowerStep.Canonical x.c1
/-- Exact lower field-domain statements, not a caller-output equation. -/
structure NBC_Fields (ops : Ops) : Prop where
 product : ∀ x q out, WideCanonical x → NBF_PowerStep.Canonical q →
   ops.op3 x q=ok out → WideCanonical out
 sum : ∀ x y out, WideCanonical x → WideCanonical y →
   ops.op2 x y=ok out → WideCanonical out
 power : NBF_PowerStep.NBC_Qm31Canonical ops
/-- The successful actual constructor supplies rhs canonicality. -/
theorem initial (base : VTop_Stages.Ops) (reserved : Bool)
 (a : verifier.Accumulator)
 (run : (Port3_Initial.install base reserved).op12 .S2=ok (.Ok a)) :
 WideCanonical a.rhs := by
 obtain ⟨_,_,rhs,_,_⟩ := Port3_Initial.accepted_fields base reserved a run
 rw [rhs]
 constructor <;> intro k <;> fin_cases k <;> decide
/-- SAME source-order tail, after the SAME produced basis and rows. The old
power is used for rhs; rho only advances the next power. No returned field
value/canonicality is supplied by the caller. -/
theorem accumulate (ops : Ops) (fields : NBC_Fields ops)
 (p : verifier.Prepared) (a out : verifier.Accumulator) (node : U32)
 (value : Stage2E) (b bout : verifier.BatchedWeights)
 (size : a.weights.val.length=64)
 (progress : S7JoinRowsTrace.Progress b.terms.val 0 (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b))
 (power : NBF_PowerStep.Canonical a.power)
 (rho : NBF_PowerStep.Canonical p.rho)
 (rhs : WideCanonical a.rhs) (input : WideCanonical value)
 (run : verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node (NBF_Accumulate.install ops)
   p a node value b=ok (out,bout)) :
 WideCanonical out.rhs ∧ NBF_PowerStep.Canonical out.power := by
 obtain ⟨basis,mid,hbasis,hrows,terms,len,phase,body⟩ := NBF_Accumulate.rows
   ops p a node value b size progress power
 rw [body] at run
 simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok] at run
 obtain ⟨product,hproduct,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
 obtain ⟨sum,hsum,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
 obtain ⟨marked,hmarked,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
 obtain ⟨nextPower,hpower,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
 cases Result.ok.inj run
 exact ⟨fields.sum a.rhs product sum rhs
   (fields.product value a.power product input power hproduct) hsum,
   fields.power a.power p.rho nextPower power rho hpower⟩
#print axioms initial
#print axioms accumulate
end NBO_TailDomain

NBO_QueryFactor.text:
import NBO_Enumerate
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBO_QueryFactor
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
abbrev Cut := Stage2E × Array Stage2E 4#usize × Array U32 5#usize
/-- Exact emitted prefix; only a.next is projected before entering. -/
def front (ops : Ops) (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared) (next : Usize)
 (g : Array Stage2E 29#usize) (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry) :
 Result (core.result.Result Cut verifier.Error) := do
  let i ← Array.index_usize p.queries next
  let u ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize i)
  let q ← ops.op11 proof next
  let dots ← ops.op20 q g
  let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize next)
  let we ← Array.index_usize dots 0#usize
  ops.op15 9#u16 i1 we
  let i2 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize next)
  let i3 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i2 1#usize)
  let we1 ← Array.index_usize dots 1#usize
  ops.op15 9#u16 i3 we1
  let i4 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize next)
  let i5 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i4 2#usize)
  let we2 ← Array.index_usize dots 2#usize
  ops.op15 9#u16 i5 we2
  let i6 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize next)
  let i7 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i6 3#usize)
  let we3 ← Array.index_usize dots 3#usize
  ops.op15 9#u16 i7 we3
  let inverse ← ops.op18 geometry next
  let we4 ← Array.index_usize p.alpha 0#usize
  let folded ← ops.op17 we4 dots inverse
  let i8 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize next)
  ops.op15 10#u16 i8 folded
  let values ←
    ops.op0 4#usize
      (verifier.candidate.query_values.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeWideExact ops)
      q
  let i9 ← u % 4#usize
  let we5 ← Array.index_usize values i9
  let b ←
    core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.trait_default
      ops.widePartialEq
      folded we5
  if b then ok (.Err verifier.Error.Query)
  else ok (.Ok (folded,values,inverse))
/-- Exact emitted accepted continuation, including the actual accumulation
body and mark. No child output is supplied independently. -/
def suffix (ops : Ops) (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
 (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry)
 (pending : verifier.BatchedWeights) (values : Array Stage2E 4#usize)
 (inverse : Array U32 5#usize) :
 Result (core.result.Result (verifier.Accumulator × verifier.BatchedWeights) verifier.Error) := do
  let we6 ← Array.index_usize p.alpha 1#usize
  let folded1 ← ops.op16 we6 values inverse
  let i10 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize a.next)
  let i11 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i10 1#usize)
  ops.op15 10#u16 i11 folded1
  let i12 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub a.next geometry.start)
  let z ←
    alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice
      aspis_core.field.M31) geometry.line_z i12
  let m ← ops.op7 z z
  let m1 ← ops.op8 m
  let m2 ← ops.op5
  let node ← ops.op6 m1 m2
  let (a1, pending1) ←
    (verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node ops) p a node folded1 pending
  ops.op19 obs (verifier.Phase.Query a.next)
  ok (core.result.Result.Ok (a1, pending1))
private theorem associate {A B C : Type} (x : Result A) (f : A → Result B)
 (g : B → Result C) : ((x >>= f) >>= g) = (x >>= fun a => f a >>= g) := by
 cases x <;> rfl
private theorem branch {A B : Type} (b : Bool) (x y : Result A) (f : A → Result B) :
 ((if b then x else y) >>= f) = (if b then x >>= f else y >>= f) := by
 cases b <;> rfl
/-- Total Result equality, including rejected prefixes and divergence.
It factors the actual emitted function, not a selected successful output. -/
theorem association (ops : Ops) (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared)
 (a : verifier.Accumulator) (g : Array Stage2E 29#usize)
 (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry)
 (pending : verifier.BatchedWeights) :
 verifier.candidate.query_values ops proof p a g obs geometry pending =
 (do let cut ← front ops proof p a.next g geometry
     match cut with
     | .Err error => ok (.Err error)
     | .Ok (_,values,inverse) => suffix ops p a obs geometry pending values inverse) := by
 unfold verifier.candidate.query_values front suffix
 simp only [associate,branch,bind_tc_ok]
#print axioms associate
#print axioms branch
#print axioms association
end NBO_QueryFactor
end

import NBO_FinishCaller
import S8Kani2FinishCertificate
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBO_Enumerate
open S8Kani2MutableExtraction.batched_weights S8Kani2MutableValue
/-- Full actual emitted Enumerate/back-continuation traversal from any
valid cursor, including exhaustion. Values are derived from the SAME raw
producer, rather than supplied as a separate successful child execution.
The destination's own bound supplies usize capacity for the ordinal. -/
theorem from_cursor (self : F.BW) (initial : FinishIter)
 (cursor : initial.iter.i ≤ initial.iter.slice.len.val)
 (ordinal : initial.count.val=initial.iter.i)
 (lengths : initial.iter.slice.val.length≤self.raw.length) :
 ∃ output : FinishIter,
   BatchedWeights.finish_loop initial (fun e=>e) self=ok output ∧
   output.iter.slice=prefixWrite (valueAt self) initial.iter.i
     initial.iter.slice.len.val initial.iter.slice := by
 apply finish_loop_output_invariant_of_values self initial (valueAt self) cursor ordinal
 · intro i hi
   apply valueAt_success
   change i.val < initial.iter.slice.val.length at hi
   exact lt_of_lt_of_le hi lengths
 · exact initial.iter.slice.property
#print axioms from_cursor
end NBO_Enumerate

import NBF_QueryLoop
import NBF_FinishTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBO_FinishCaller
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
/-- Finish consumes the SAME query-produced raw state and SAME original
weight destination. Its entire Result is derived, with no finish-success
hypothesis and no independently selected destination contents. Native caller
association remains a separate obligation. -/
theorem from_query (base : VTop_Stages.Ops) (reserved : Bool)
 (ops : Ops) (field : NBF_PowerStep.NBC_Qm31Canonical ops)
 (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared) (g : Array Stage2E 29#usize)
 (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry) (rho : NBF_PowerStep.Canonical p.rho)
 (a out : verifier.Accumulator) (b bout : verifier.BatchedWeights)
 (initial : (Port3_Initial.install base reserved).op12 .S2=ok (.Ok a))
 (pending : Port3_NativePendingInstall.source reserved a.weights.deref=ok (.Ok b))
 (run : verifier.candidate.query_loop (NBF_Accumulate.install ops)
   proof p a g none geometry b 10#usize=ok (.Ok (out,bout))) :
 ∃ finished : Slice NBF_RowInstall.Q,
   Port3_FlushInstall.flush bout a.weights.deref=ok finished ∧
   finished.val.length=64 ∧
   finished.val=(bout.raw.val.take 64).map NBF_FinishTrace.value ∧
   (∀ q ∈ finished.val, Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical q) ∧
   out.next.val=10 ∧ bout.terms.val=10 ∧
   S7JoinRowsTrace.Progress 10 0 (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW bout) := by
 obtain ⟨next,terms,_,raw,progress⟩ := NBF_QueryLoop.from_constructors
   base reserved ops field proof p g geometry rho a out b bout initial pending run
 obtain ⟨_,good⟩ := NBF_QueryInitial.good base reserved a b initial pending
 obtain ⟨finished,hfinish,len,contents,canonical⟩ := NBB_Finish.source
   bout a.weights.deref raw good.weights
 exact ⟨finished,hfinish,len,contents,canonical,next,terms,progress⟩
#print axioms from_query
end NBO_FinishCaller

NBO_GeometryDomain.text:
import NBO_QueryRhs
import Port5Q1_GeometryAccessor
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBO_GeometryDomain
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
/-- Derive both checked native geometry offsets and the canonical node input
from the SAME geometry carrier. No selected z or successful read is supplied. -/
theorem node_input (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry)
 (domain : NBO_QueryDomains.GeometryDomain geometry) (i : Usize) (active : i.val<10) :
 geometry.start.val ≤ i.val ∧
 (Usize.wrapping_sub i geometry.start).val=i.val ∧
 ∃ z, alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice U32)
   geometry.line_z (Usize.wrapping_sub i geometry.start)=ok z ∧ z.val<2147483647 := by
 have order : geometry.start.val ≤ i.val := by rw [domain.start];change 0 ≤ i.val;omega
 have offset : (Usize.wrapping_sub i geometry.start).val=i.val := by
   rw [Port5Q1_GeometryAccessor.offset i geometry.start order,domain.start]
   rfl
 have bound : (Usize.wrapping_sub i geometry.start).val < geometry.line_z.val.length := by
   rw [offset,domain.lineLength];exact active
 obtain ⟨z,run,contents⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
   (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec geometry.line_z (Usize.wrapping_sub i geometry.start) bound)
 refine ⟨order,offset,z,run,?_⟩
 rw [contents]
 exact domain.line _ (List.getElem_mem _)
#print axioms node_input
end NBO_GeometryDomain
